content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. SRIC/06 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT Roorkee notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology or related disciplines, with training relevant to molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, bioinformatics or computational biology. Other conditions: Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates with equal qualifications and experience. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Desirable: Research experience in structural biochemistry and computational biology, including protein modelling, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, bioinformatics and genomic data analysis. Familiarity with microbiological techniques, bacterial culture, sequence analysis and BLAST. Experience with molecular visualization and analysis tools such as PyMOL, GROMACS, LigPlot, RasMol. Experience in Python, AI/ML and LLMs, along with exposure to protein structure-function analysis and interdisciplinary research workflows.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Basic Microbiology Routine Work Computational protein analysis, modelling, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation Bioinformatics, genomic/sequence analysis and interpretation of biological data Support for molecular biology, microbiology and interdisciplinary research workflows

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Roorkee Select Candidates?
Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in plain paper with a detailed CV including a chronological discipline of the degrees/certificates obtained Experience including research, industrial field and others Attested copies of the degree/certificate and experience certificate Original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit applications with documents to the office of the Principal Investigator through email, by post or produce them at the time of the Interview. Attend the walk-in interview on 16-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates with equal qualifications and experience. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application in plain paper with a detailed CV including a chronological discipline of the degrees/certificates obtained; Experience including research, industrial field and others; Attested copies of the degree/certificate and experience certificate; Original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. SRIC/06.
